topic: Joy Boy is one of only two people Imu genuinely fears, and the Egghead Haki burst is why that fear is justified
title: Joy Boy Is The One Person Imu Still Fears
description: According to Rocks D. Xebec, Joy Boy is one of only two people Nerona Imu genuinely fears, the other being the pirate Davy D. Jones. The Egghead Incident shows exactly why. From the full story: The Void Century: Everything Joy Boy Left Behind.
comment: Is Imu really the final villain of this story, or is there someone above him? Pick one.
